metadata.title: Nuclear War (Base) — Full Card List with Consolidated Text
metadata.edition_scope: Base 1965 set only (no expansions). Uses publisher cardlist for names/counts; card texts consolidated from community sources.

sources_index.title: Nuclear War Card List (publisher list mirror)
sources_index.notes: Names & counts for base deck; lists the 10 base Secrets & 5 Top Secrets by name.

sources_index.notes: Community consolidation; NOT official. Anti‑missile summary, attack tables, and many card texts across sets.

cards.name: Test Ban
cards.unofficial_text: TEST BAN! Your President declares a test ban on nuclear weapons. The targeted country forfeits its next turn.

cards.name: Summit Talk
cards.unofficial_text: You have tricked the enemy into an ineffective but time‑consuming summit talk. The targeted country loses one full turn.

cards.name: Stock Market Super Boom
cards.unofficial_text: STOCK MARKET SUPER BOOM! 2 million of the enemy’s population immigrate to your country.

cards.name: Peace Corps
cards.unofficial_text: PEACE CORPS REDUCES COLD WAR TENSIONS! 2 million of the enemy’s people leave their homeland to join your form of superior government.

cards.name: First on Moon
cards.unofficial_text: YOUR COLD WAR PRESTIGE SOARS DUE TO BEING FIRST ON THE MOON! 5 million of the enemy defect to seek aerospace jobs in your country.

cards.name: Beatnik Pacifists
cards.unofficial_text: BEATNIK PACIFISTS! 2 million of the enemy’s population defect to your country.

cards.name: Population Explosion
cards.unofficial_text: POPULATION EXPLOSION! Your country experiences a baby boom — gain 5 million population from the bank.
cards.notes: Magnitude inferred; mark for verification against card scan.

cards.name: Little Old Ladies
cards.unofficial_text: 2 million of your highly moral little old ladies rebel against your country’s military policies and defect to the player who played this card.

cards.name: Raises Taxes
cards.unofficial_text: YOUR ENEMY RAISES TAXES 100% THIS YEAR! 5 million of his people emigrate to your country.

cards.name: Ambassador Gets Drunk
cards.unofficial_text: ENEMY AMBASSADOR GETS DRUNK AT UN PARTY! His country loses one turn to restore diplomatic relations.

cards.name: Disastrous Earthquake
cards.unofficial_text: DISASTROUS EARTHQUAKE! 10 million of the targeted country’s population are killed.

cards.name: 10 Million Leave for a Neutral Country
cards.unofficial_text: 10 MILLION LEAVE FOR A NEUTRAL COUNTRY. Remove 10 million from the targeted country and return them to the bank.

cards.name: Supergerm
cards.unofficial_text: SUPERGERM! A virulent plague strikes. 25 million are lost from the targeted country.
cards.notes: Community summary; verify exact magnitude against card scan or official listing.

cards.name: Mysteriously Vaporized
cards.unofficial_text: 25 million of the enemy’s population are mysteriously vaporized.

cards.name: Violent Tornado
cards.unofficial_text: A VIOLENT TORNADO results in a loss of 10 million to the targeted country’s population.
